description: This PHP source file defines the class 'HTMLPurifier_Printer_ConfigForm' along with related classes, which are responsible for rendering a configuration form for the HTML Purifier library. The code includes methods for generating HTML, CSS, and JavaScript content, handling form elements for directives, and decorating existing printers to support null values.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Printer_ConfigForm
classes.description: A printer class responsible for rendering an HTML form for configuring directives within the HTML Purifier library. It manages form fields, styling, JavaScript, and rendering logic for directives and their values.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Printer_ConfigForm_NullDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for directives that accept null, adding a checkbox to enable or disable the directive value.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Printer_ConfigForm_default
classes.description: A generic form field printer supporting text areas, select inputs, and other default input types.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Printer_ConfigForm_bool
classes.description: A form field printer for boolean (true/false) directives, represented as radio buttons.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the form with a name, optional documentation URL, and optional compression length.

methods.name: setTextareaDimensions
methods.description: Sets default size for textarea fields in the form.

methods.name: getCSS
methods.description: Retrieves CSS styling for the configuration form.

methods.name: getJavaScript
methods.description: Retrieves JavaScript code for the configuration form.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Generates the HTML output for the configuration form based on the current configuration object or array.

methods.name: renderNamespace
methods.description: Renders a specific namespace's directives within the form, including labels and input elements.

methods.name: render
methods.description: In 'HTMLPurifier_Printer_ConfigForm_NullDecorator', renders checkbox and value input for directives that can be null.

methods.name: render
methods.description: In 'HTMLPurifier_Printer_ConfigForm_default', renders default input fields (text, textarea, select) for directive values.

methods.name: render
methods.description: In 'HTMLPurifier_Printer_ConfigForm_bool', renders radio buttons for boolean directives.
